Name: Reuel, Father of Shephathiah
Summary: Father of Shephathiah in the Jerusalem list, son of Ibnijah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:8: Father of Shephathiah in the Jerusalem list, son of Ibnijah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Reuel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
